prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-detail RGBA paper-theatre component atlas for Pokémon Emerald Shoal Cave ice chamber. ONE landscape 1536x1024 image, exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows of twelve separated components, generous transparent gutters. No words, grid, floor, or backing sheet. Medium: layered hand-cut paper, elegant translucent-looking pale blue tracing paper layered over cobalt cardstock, thin warm-white cut edges, delicate etched frost patterns and overlapping individual panels. Premium illustrated paper pop-up, NOT solid 3D crystals, not low-poly rock models, not photoreal ice. Front-facing, slight elevated view only on low ground props. Blue, cyan, muted indigo, silver white. No glow clouds.
Row 1:
1. Tall narrow asymmetrical ice-wall wing open toward right, made from multiple overlapping long thin jagged tracing-paper sheets, detailed frost branch veins.
2. Different tall narrow ice-wall wing open toward left, composed of scalloped frozen paper fins, small snow caps, visible thin edges.
3. Low wide distant ice ridge, layered indigo and azure flat silhouettes with paper-cut openings in its upper edge, not a complete cave.
4. THREE individually separated long thin pale cyan paper icicles with tiny internal white frost lines, spaced horizontally, NO joining bar.
Row 2:
1. Tall frozen waterfall RIBBON, narrow flowing folds of blue tracing paper with thin white ridges, fine crystalline cracks, no rocks/background.
2. A modest freestanding cluster of five thin ice crystal silhouettes, different heights, cutout paper sheets visibly overlap, frost patterns, no chunky polygon solids.
3. Low wide frozen pool, irregular pale blue layered paper surface with intricate white hairline cracks, tiny scalloped snow edge, no rocks behind.
4. THREE large different delicate six-armed paper snowflakes, vertically spaced and isolated, white and very pale cyan, visible cut edges, each separate.
Row 3:
1. Low flat-topped ice ledge made from stacked thin uneven white-blue paper slabs, dry snow on top, detailed layered edges.
2. Small snow drift with two protruding dark blue flat rock silhouettes, delicate cut-paper frost fern on one side.
3. Low compact loose shards: many fine jagged paper ice slivers overlapping, sparkling printed white facets but no artificial glow.
4. THREE small individual snowflakes vertically spaced on the left half, and THREE tiny detached blue-white frost chips on the right half, all separate.
No whole scene, arena, ball, people, Pokemon, labels, text, checkerboard or ground shadow. Every object contained in its cell. Truly transparent outside all objects.
